items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: On first tenor we had Lucky Thompson.

ctx.x: on second tenor. On first tenor we had Lucky Thompson. On baritone, we had a young fellow who before had been playing alto saxophone, but he wanted to get in the band when the band was being organized, so Billy Eckstine asked him if he would play baritone saxophone, and he agreed to do it, and Billy bought him a baritone, and so he became the baritone saxophone player. [LEO PARKER] So those were the five saxophones.

In the trumpet section, we had on first trumpet Gail Brockman. On second trumpet, Buddy Anderson, a fine, fine trumpet player. Buddy Anderson was from Oklahoma City, but he had come from Jay McShann's band, as well as Charlie Parker. Buddy Anderson played second trumpet. Shorty McConnell, formerly with the Earl Hines band, played third trumpet. And fourth trumpet was Dizzy Gillespie.

items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: So a lot of the guys in the and were sniggering and laughing at Lucky and

ctx.x: on your hair... At that particular time, they used lye in it. And that I guess was what the straightener was. When you put it on your hair, the first thing you did, you put a lot of Vaseline on your hair and then you put this stuff in to keep it from burning. But you could only let it stay on for a certain length of time, and then you had to wash it out. Lucky Thompson got up early that morning and was going to do his hair, and got this stuff in his hair before he realized that they had cut the water off in the…

So we came out, and somebody suggested first to stick his head in the commode. So someone else said, "No. There's another hotel across the street." So he ran across the street, because their water isn't cut off. And it was during the morning rush. We lived on one of the main streets. And it was during the morning, so people are going to work, you know. So he runs across the street in his shorts and this towel into the hotel, and got this stuff washed out of his head.
